features.F0: five A027 combinations, last valid <=M-1 and mean finite values in natural M-3..M-1
features.augmentation: 26 prior complete events +6 latest incomplete-well events; per-event cutoff, all validation-well events excluded; append after original training rows; stable well/anchor/step order

boundary: history and raw target scale <=M-1; target M+1..M+12
metric: epsilon1e-6; unnormalized2^-t t1..12; per-well then equal-well mean
Dalpha: same locked R4 pure calculation; delta1e-6; other-four-fold same-horizon residual samples; zero first candidate; first exact minimum
Dalpha_limitation: prescribed cross-estimated diagnostic, not nested model validation; labels of current fold excluded directly but other-fold models may include those wells
FM_blend_ties: equal selection score prefers larger baseline w
selection_simplicity: within 0.1 of maximum qualifying delta: no FM first; fewer active mechanisms (F0/AUG/ALPHA/FM); fewer added features; no augmentation; no residual adjustment; stable identifier final tie

decisions_verbatim.A2B-028:
| Codex 确认的结果 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| B0 复现失败，或任一硬门禁失败 | 全部停止 |
| 某候选分数差 ≥ +1.0 且 5 折中 ≥4 折为正 | 该候选成为保留候选；多个达标时取分数差最大者，差距 ≤0.1 时取配置更简单者；建议用户批准打包与平台提交（另行批准） |
| 最佳候选 0 < 分数差 < +1.0，或达标折数 < 4 | 弱信号，交用户决定，默认不执行 |
| 所有候选分数差 ≤ 0 | 阶段 1 方向淘汰，维持 A2B-013/B0 |
decisions_verbatim.A2B-029:
| Codex 确认的结果 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| 零样本得分 < 70 | 关闭方向 ④（本模型） |
| 零样本 ≥ 70，融合分数差 ≥ +1.0 且 ≥4/5 折为正 | 融合成为保留候选，与 A2B-028 候选按同一规则比较；打包与平台提交另行批准 |
| 零样本 ≥ 70，但融合未达上一行 | 弱信号，交用户决定，默认不执行 |

privacy: anonymous aggregates only; no row OOF, IDs, calendar months, labels, predictions or raw rows on disk; local IPC only
